name: Darts VR: Real Room
summary:
Turn your room into a personal mixed-reality darts space with Darts VR: Real Room.

Place a regulation-size virtual dartboard, take a dart in either hand, aim, and throw using intuitive Touch controller interactions. Passthrough keeps your real surroundings visible while the dartboard, darts, scoring displays, and oche remain virtual.
